package.name: cooptrans_sim
package.description: Quasi-static kinematic plant for software-in-the-loop testing VENDORED into swdr_ws so this workspace is self-contained and a robot NUC needs no other checkout. The original lives in cooptrans_ws (the RA-L / TurtleBot workspace); THIS copy is the swerve variant and is the one the swerve launches use. Edit this one for swerve work -- changes here do NOT propagate to cooptrans_ws, and vice versa.
